title: Newtonsoft.Json
description: The popular Json.NET library for JSON serialization with extensive features and flexibility.

data.text: Newtonsoft.Json (Json.NET) is a popular high-performance JSON framework for .NET. It has been the de facto standard for years and offers extensive features like LINQ to JSON, custom converters, and flexible serialization settings.

data.title: Serialization with Settings

terms.definition: The main class for converting objects to and from JSON.
Allows fine-grained control over serialization behavior.

data.title: Migration
data.text: For new projects, prefer System.Text.Json. Use Newtonsoft.Json when you need features not yet supported by System.Text.Json.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Newtonsoft.Json remains a solid choice for complex JSON scenarios.

data.title: Exercise
data.expectedOutcome: Custom JSON conversion logic applied during serialization.
